sloka: क्रीडमानाश्च विस्रब्धा मत्ताह् शून्ये महामृगाः ।दृष्ट्वा समभिवर्तन्ते सीते दुःखमतो वनम् ॥२-२८-८॥
transliteration: krīḍamānāśca visrabdhā mattāh śūnye mahāmṛgāḥ ।dṛṣṭvā samabhivartante sīte duḥkhamato vanam ॥2-28-8॥

translations.english: Big, wild animals, moving about freely and sporting in the deserted forest, attack on seeing a human. Thus forest is full of danger.
